newsitem.title: UK: Eastern Electric to cut prices up to 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Electric to cut prices up to 9 pct.

text.p: Eastern Electricity, a unit of Energy Group plc, said on Tuesday it was cutting its rates by 6-9 percent effective April 1.
In a statement, the company said the average annual savings for its three million customers would be around 18 to 30 stg.
Southern Electric plc earlier on Tuesday announced a cut of an average of 7.2 percent for its 2.6 million customers.
Eastern said it had achieved savings from the reductions in both the UK's fossil fuel levy and the National Grid's transmission charges.
It also said it was introducing new tariffs. Customers using more than 225 stg of electricity a year will pay a lower rate after they have used 702 units per quarter (about 60 stg).
